title: Tofu fajita peppers
summary: Tofu fajita peppers is a mexican dinner built around firm tofu and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice firm tofu and red peppers before the pan is hot. Tofu fajita peppers is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry firm tofu until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add red peppers and yellow peppers, return firm tofu, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Tofu fajita peppers before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

image.alt: Tofu fajita peppers served for dinner
